ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a single loop a-b-c-d. On the upper branch between a and b there is a resistor R1, and current I1 is to the right; on the right branch between b and c there is a voltage source E1, with current I2 marked beside it downward; on the lower branch between d and c there is a voltage source E2 and a resistor R2, and current I3 is to the right; on the left branch between a and d there is a resistor R3, and current I4 is downward. The dashed arrow in the middle of the loop indicates traversal in the clockwise direction. Reasoning: Write KVL clockwise along the dashed direction from a→b→c→d→a. When passing through R1, it is in the same direction as I1, so it is a voltage drop, denoted as -I1R1; when passing through E1, according to the polarity shown in the figure it is a voltage rise, denoted as +E1; from c to d, when passing through R2, it is opposite to the direction of I3, denoted as +I3R2; when passing through E2, it is a voltage rise, denoted as +E2; from d to a, when passing through R3, it is opposite to the direction of I4, denoted as +I4R3. By KVL: -I1R1 + E1 + I3R2 + E2 + I4R3 = 0. Rearranging and simplifying gives: I1R1 - I3R2 - I4R3 = E1 + E2.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: a single mesh a-b-c-d contains R1 on the top branch with I1 to the right, E1 on the right branch, E2 and R2 on the bottom branch with I3 to the right, and R3 on the left branch with I4 downward; the dashed arrow indicates clockwise traversal. Then traverse clockwise a→b→c→d→a. Record voltage changes: across R1, -I1R1; across E1, +E1; across R2 from c to d opposite I3, +I3R2; across E2, +E2; across R3 from d to a opposite I4, +I4R3. Set the algebraic sum to zero by KVL and rearrange to obtain I1R1 - I3R2 - I4R3 = E1 + E2.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个单回路 a-b-c-d。上支路 a 到 b 之间有电阻 R1，电流 I1 向右；右支路 b 到 c 之间有电源 E1，旁边标有电流 I2 向下；下支路 d 到 c 之间有电源 E2 和电阻 R2，电流 I3 向右；左支路 a 到 d 之间有电阻 R3，电流 I4 向下。回路中间的虚线箭头表示按顺时针方向绕行。
推理：按虚线方向从 a→b→c→d→a 顺时针列 KVL。经过 R1 时与 I1 同向，为电压降，记为 -I1R1；经过 E1 按图示极性为电压升，记为 +E1；从 c 到 d 经过 R2 时与 I3 方向相反，记为 +I3R2；经过 E2 时为电压升，记为 +E2；从 d 到 a 经过 R3 时与 I4 方向相反，记为 +I4R3。由 KVL：-I1R1 + E1 + I3R2 + E2 + I4R3 = 0。移项整理得：I1R1 - I3R2 - I4R3 = E1 + E2。
